lines.text: Give a large language model a simple instruction, such as write a story.
with the familiar words, "Once upon a time."
From the outside, that looks almost effortless.
But underneath this simple interaction is a very large sequence of numerical operations.
In this video, I will show you why compressing those operations is difficult, build up the main ideas behind modern LLM pruning, and then introduce the method we developed: Thanos.
